Name: Flower Meads
Author: revenorror
Description:
In the regular game, all different types of honey will only produce the generic mead, which sells for less than almost all types of the honey you use to make it. Not any more! Mead will now be renamed and have its price adjusted to reflect the type of honey used, making beekeeping much more viable.

Unfortunately, while there have been some mods to rectify this (the fantastic [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3241]Swizzy Meads[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3609]Quality Products[/url], for instance) the feature to rename the new meads seems to have broken as of update 1.4. My mod is made utilizing the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url]﻿ which provides greater compatibility with other mods and more insulation against breaking if the base game is updated, while providing the same functionality. 

[size=3][b]To install:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Requires the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url]﻿
[*]If you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url]﻿, install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5038]PFMAutomate [/url]﻿as well.
[*]Copy the folder "[PFM] Flower Mead" to your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[/list]
